cards.t: Cysic Bridge Suspended Following Unauthorized Mint
cards.b: Cysic suspended its crypto bridge after an unauthorized mint of 10 million CYS tokens, with the attacker bridging about $727,000 to Ethereum.

per.CYS: Bridge suspended and tokens minted unauthorizedly.

cards.label: NEGATIVE CATALYST
cards.missing: Full recovery status of funds and timeline for bridge reactivation
